name: retainer-v1
why: The Fusion 360 retainer recreation, which killed the worker once treatments were built on a copy of their input: the chamfer's history was asked about a face its input no longer had (one the cut's face merge had replaced), BRepTools_Modifier::ModifiedShape raised Standard_NoSuchObject, and nothing caught it. Such a shape is now neither modified nor kept. The part must build with its 23 faces (14 plane, 6 cylinder, 2 cone, 1 torus) and the exact volume its header gives, 143829.66 mm3 against Fusion's 143825.63.
